name: Hotel Berghof
beschreibung: The Hotel Berghof is located in Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal. The rooms are furnished in Tiroler Landhausstil and have a balcony and a view of the Allgäuer Alpen. The sauna area and the sunbathing lawn are available to guests. The restaurant serves regional Tiroler cuisine. In summer, the surrounding area serves as a hiking area and in winter as a ski area for ski tours and cross-country skiing. The stay is characterized by the quiet location and the personal service.
